evals.prompt: what skills and MCP servers load in this project, and what do they cost?
evals.expected_output: Runs agentry status --json (not reading ~/.claude.json or settings by hand); summarizes skills.items and mcp.servers by scope with tokens.measured, says MCP tool lists are not measured, and never prints env or header values.

evals.prompt: my sessions feel slow and I think I have duplicate MCP servers
evals.expected_output: Runs agentry doctor --json, reports dup-mcp-scope / dup-mcp-plugin findings with their files, and offers agentry fix; does not edit .claude.json or .mcp.json directly.

evals.prompt: check all my repos under ~/ws for setup problems and fix what you can
evals.expected_output: Runs agentry scan ~/ws --only-problems --json, summarizes global versus per-repo findings, then proposes agentry scan --fix and waits for the user's go-ahead before running it; findings without an automatic fix are explained, not hand-edited.
